title: Emergence of Hierarchical Emotion Organization in Large Language Models
findings: The study found specific religious biases in emotion recognition. For example, when adopting a Hindu persona, the Llama model frequently misclassified negative emotions (from the 'anger,' 'fear,' and 'sadness' categories) as 'guilt'.
